items.title: Cohomological descent for the comparison of the h-topology with the small etale topos
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes cohomological descent for the comparison between the h-topology and the small etale topos, for complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves (statement lines 22769-22777). The proof (proof lines 22779-22807) reduces to a single torsion sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, rewrites the composite pushforward by the description of the pullback, and degenerates the relative Leray spectral sequence using the V-C statement and the etale cohomological descent. H2: one reduction plus one spectral sequence degeneration, written out.
